author: Coastalgirl74
quote:
Lucia has just got out of jail, and Jason is at the party looking like a lost puppy. 
I was really enjoying life with Jason before she came out. To learn she ran off and had the child and didn’t tell him, then to see his face when he finds out he is the father. 

All she is interested in is seeing her friends on boats and rolling in money. 

I know it’s a story but it’s morally affecting me. 
Maybe because there is a child and the father wants to do the right thing. 

I am not getting romantically involved with her, she is annoying as hell, disrespectful and I just want to play as Jason. At least he has a moral compass.
